description: This file defines a static class 'InvokablePool' responsible for managing object pooling of IInvokable implementations, including methods to get and return pooled objects, as well as a generic internal class for pool management.

classes.name: InvokablePool
classes.description: Provides static methods for obtaining and returning invokable objects from a pool.

classes.name: TypedPool<T>
classes.description: Internal generic class managing a concurrent object pool for a specific type implementing IInvokable.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of type T from the pool.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Returns an instance of type T to the pool.
